project_overview: 警务案件管理系统，用于案件注册、调查、起诉和搜索，提高警务工作效率和信息安全性

actors.name: Admin
actors.description: System administrator with full access rights

actors.name: PoliceOfficer
actors.description: Police personnel using the system for case management

actors.name: Citizen
actors.description: Public user reporting cases or accessing public data

actors.name: HelpDesk
actors.description: Support staff handling system issues and enhancement requests

actors.name: RecordsStaff
actors.description: Personnel managing case records and documentation

actors.name: ExternalAuditor
actors.description: Authorized external personnel who audit system activities

functions.name: CustomizeUI
functions.description: Customize user interface elements and layouts
acceptance_criteria: 配置随用户配置文件保存
UI remains accessible for special needs users

functions.name: ExportAudit
functions.description: Export audit trail data for external review
acceptance_criteria: 导出不影响系统审计跟踪
Audit data remains unaltered during export
Reports can be organized by case/user/chronology
Exported data is complete and accurate
Format is usable by external auditors

functions.name: InvestigateCase
acceptance_criteria: Case status updates reflect investigation progress
All evidence and notes are properly recorded
Access is restricted based on authorization
functions.preconditions: 案件已注册且状态为'新案件'

functions.name: ManageAccess
functions.description: Configure user access rights to cases
acceptance_criteria: Only super-users can modify security attributes

functions.name: ManageConfig
acceptance_criteria: 配置变更记录在审计跟踪中

functions.name: ProsecuteCase
functions.preconditions: 案件调查已完成且证据充分

functions.name: RegisterCase
functions.description: Register new police cases in the system
acceptance_criteria: 案件状态初始化为'新案件'
functions.preconditions: 用户已登录并具有相应权限

functions.name: SearchCase
functions.description: Search for cases based on various criteria
acceptance_criteria: 搜索结果在5-8秒内返回（简单搜索）
搜索结果在10-15秒内返回（高级搜索）
仅显示用户有权访问的案件
Search results are returned within performance requirements
functions.preconditions: 用户已登录并具有相应权限

functions.name: TrackDefect
functions.description: Log and track application defects or enhancement requests
acceptance_criteria: 用户可收到状态更新通知
User can submit defect with all required fields
Help desk can view defect reports by category/status/age
Users receive alerts when defect status changes

functions.name: ViewReports
acceptance_criteria: 报告按案件、用户和时间顺序生成
报告可按工作站和网络地址组织
Access is restricted based on authorization

constraints.descriptionZh: 系统必须在20秒内检索并显示最近2个月内未访问过的案件
constraints.canonicalRuleEn: 系统必须在20秒内检索并显示最近2个月内未访问过的案件
constraints.sourceText: The System must be able to retrieve and display within 20 seconds the case which has not been accessed within the previous 2 months, regardless of storage capacity or number of cases in the system. exceptions.trigger: 尝试访问不存在的案件
exceptions.handling: 显示错误消息并记录到审计跟踪

exceptions.trigger: 尝试导出审计跟踪但功能未激活
exceptions.handling: 显示错误消息并提示激活审计功能

exceptions.trigger: 搜索操作超过规定时间
exceptions.handling: 终止搜索并显示超时错误

exceptions.trigger: 尝试执行需要登录的操作
exceptions.handling: 重定向到登录页面

exceptions.trigger: 用户尝试访问没有权限的案件
exceptions.handling: 根据配置显示不同级别的响应（显示标题和元数据/仅显示存在/完全不显示）

exceptions.trigger: Error during audit trail export
exceptions.handling: Notify administrator and preserve original audit data

exceptions.trigger: Error during audit trail export process
exceptions.handling: Log error and notify administrator

exceptions.trigger: Requested case does not exist
exceptions.handling: Show meaningful error message

exceptions.description: Case registration fails due to missing mandatory property evidence
exceptions.trigger: When registering case without linking required property evidence
exceptions.handling: System should prevent submission and highlight missing evidence requirements

exceptions.trigger: Case retrieval exceeds performance thresholds
exceptions.handling: Notify user and suggest alternative actions

exceptions.trigger: Required fields missing in defect report
exceptions.handling: Show meaningful error message with guidance

exceptions.trigger: Defect tracking subsystem is offline
exceptions.handling: Queue requests and process when system is available

exceptions.description: Mobile device fails authentication during critical operation
exceptions.trigger: When network drops during mobile authentication process
exceptions.handling: Preserve operation data locally and require re-authentication when connection resumes

exceptions.description: Multilingual content unavailable for specific case metadata
exceptions.trigger: When viewing case details in unsupported language
exceptions.handling: Fallback to primary language with visual indication of untranslated content

exceptions.description: Offline modifications conflict with central system updates
exceptions.trigger: When synchronizing offline changes that conflict with central updates
exceptions.handling: Present conflict resolution interface to investigator with audit trail of both versions

exceptions.trigger: Search takes longer than allowed time
exceptions.handling: Show timeout message and suggest refining search

exceptions.trigger: User attempts to access case without proper permissions
exceptions.handling: Log attempt in audit trail and display configured response

exceptions.trigger: User tries to access restricted case
exceptions.handling: Log violation and show configured response

exceptions.trigger: User attempts to access case without permission
exceptions.handling: Log attempt in audit trail and show configured response

exceptions.trigger: When loading corrupted UI customization preferences
exceptions.handling: Revert to default interface with notification and option to restore last valid configuration

non_functional_requirements.description: 系统必须在5-8秒内执行简单搜索，在10-15秒内执行高级搜索
系统必须保持不可更改的审计跟踪
系统用户界面必须适合有特殊需求的用户
系统必须可扩展，不得有任何阻止在小或大型警察局使用的特性
UI complies with ISO 9241 accessibility standards
System must maintain complete and unalterable audit trails
System must comply with accessibility standards and guidelines
